purpose: Learn from controlled added codec stages on real music, supported by fully controlled synthetic originals, without mistaking unknown-history commercial originals for never-lossy ground truth.

relationship_to_release_study.pilot_observed_sources: Development-only after any waveform experiment; cannot later be presented as fresh blind release validation
relationship_to_release_study.pilot_results: Must be separately labelled exploratory, not completion or failure of the frozen study

initial_construction_bounds_proposed_bef.expansion: Do not silently expand after observing scores. Record a prospective decision first.

selection_and_grouping: Resolve the known artist/title duplicate before selection; metadata match is a review flag, not proof of identical audio
Bind deterministic selection order and exact private source list before construction
Check metadata across the entire inventory for related versions; do not count store folders as independent production providers
Keep every original, rewrap, codec version, crop and processing variant of a recording together
Use artist, album, credited remix and known work relationships for conservative pilot grouping; unknown personnel/session lineage remains an explicit limitation
No claim that 112 artist strings represent 112 independent scientific groups
questions: Are equal-PCM WAV and FLAC presentations measurement-equivalent?
What changes when an additional MP3 or AAC stage is applied to the same music?
Which changes survive gain, equalization, resampling and dithering?
Do patterns learned from fully controlled synthesis transfer at all to real-music interventions?
interpretation_limits: A paired change or ability to distinguish untreated from re-encoded library files is not accuracy for ever-lossy history
Unknown originals cannot provide a verified clean false-positive denominator
Synthetic detection rates describe generated material, not commercial-music accuracy
Repeated encodes do not enlarge the independent source count
Any library-based model fit requires a further explicit training and rights decision; intake authority does not clear public weights or copyrighted-audio redistribution
required_before_audio_construction: Finalize and bind exact input selection, technical eligibility and duplicate/grouping checks
Record executable encoder/decoder versions, exact codec settings and transformations
Whole-file input preservation hashes and no-clobber output manifest
Explicit distinction between full files and any extracted intervals
Synthetic generator specification with no unknown audio samples
Confirm storage headroom and retain outputs only in ignored project temporary storage
required_before_model_scores: Separate prospective exploratory analysis plan, split assignments, metrics, model-fit limits and stopping rules
No borrowing of sealed historical data, release-evaluation sources or scores
No reuse of pilot observations as blind validation evidence
prohibited_actions: Upload library audio or private inventory
Publish or distribute generated commercial-audio copies or trained weights without clearance
Contact providers, create accounts, spend money or merge/publish a release without separate authority
